$schema_note: Generated from status-vocabulary.md tables; edit both together. Source: Universal Canon v4 Law 3 and Evidence Standard.

badge_shapes.run: spinning ring · ink-primary (transient: a check is in progress)

capability_states.label: Ready
capability_states.meaning: Verified working now: the tool launched, the service answered, the reading was measured.

capability_states.label: Pending verification
capability_states.meaning: Present or configured, not yet confirmed working.

capability_states.label: Sample
capability_states.meaning: Placeholder or demonstration data. Never shown without this label.

capability_states.label: Unknown
capability_states.meaning: No information either way — e.g. the bridge did not report this field.

capability_states.label: Error
capability_states.meaning: Tried and failed. Show the failure text and the next step.

capability_states.label: Not connected
capability_states.meaning: The service exists but is not running or not reachable (e.g. launcher on localhost:9192, telemetry on :9191).

capability_states.label: Offline
capability_states.meaning: Needs the network, and the machine is offline. Local features keep working.

capability_states.label: Unavailable
capability_states.meaning: Not present on this drive or machine (missing tool, missing hardware).

capability_states.label: Disabled
capability_states.meaning: Turned off on purpose by the operator or policy.

capability_states.label: Unsupported
capability_states.meaning: Cannot work in this environment (OS, WinPE, architecture, browser).

evidence_labels.label: Verified
evidence_labels.meaning: Inspected, executed or measured, with evidence linked.

evidence_labels.label: Partially tested
evidence_labels.meaning: Some paths exercised; the gap is named.

evidence_labels.label: Implemented
evidence_labels.meaning: Built and syntax-checked; not exercised in the target environment.

command_preview.label: Copied — not run
command_preview.rule: A command shown or copied is not executed until the Local Launcher or an explicit operator action runs it.
